summary: Split balance-history checkpoints into a required core artifact and an optional script-registry sidecar
details: The snapshot builder now emits independently hashed, signed, verified, and finalized core and script-registry SQLite artifacts from one sealed BTC checkpoint; the core database contains balances, live UTXOs, and block commitments but no script-registry table.

The standalone registry uses a frozen WITHOUT ROWID schema and has independent job, verification, completion, and failure state, so registry failure does not revoke an already completed core artifact.
Core artifacts always contain the complete live UTXO set, and both core and registry export reject a RocksDB workspace whose durable height differs from the sealed target.
Snapshot builder state and artifact manifests use the new split v1 contracts directly; legacy single-file builder jobs and artifacts are not accepted by the new tool.
The mainnet wrapper fails closed for finalization, installation, packaging, and remote publication until the split-artifact deployment pipeline is completed.
operator_actions: Use a new snapshot-builder root and regenerate split artifacts before publishing a release that contains this change; do not reuse legacy single-file builder state.
